title: RepoHone diagnosis record
description: Pass 1 of retrospective reasoning (LEARNING_PLAN 11): cause and required property only. A diagnosis is a hypothesis, never a fact, and never names a mechanism - the repository has not been surveyed yet (Phase 4) and selection is Phase 5. Analysis output, kept in separate records from the immutable session evidence.

repository_id.description: The session's repository, copied in when the diagnosis is written (contract 1.24) so recurrence reads the diagnosis alone. Null when the checkout has no remote.

developer_id.description: The session's developer, copied in with repository_id (contract 1.24). Null when Git names no user.email.

outcome.description: ARCHITECTURE 12.3. Exactly one terminal state. INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE and NO_ACTIONABLE_PROJECT_IMPROVEMENT are successful outcomes, not errors.

class.description: LEARNING_PLAN 6. The taxonomy evolves only when beta evidence shows a missing category.

required_property.description: The property the project is missing, stated as a property of the project - never a mechanism that would provide it. 'handlers must not import persistence directly', not 'add an import-linter rule'.

evidence_against.description: Load-bearing (LEARNING_PLAN 11): a retrospective that cannot articulate contradicting evidence will manufacture proposals. An empty list is an assertion that none was found, not an excuse to omit the question.

isolated.description: ARCHITECTURE 12.1 - true when reasoning ran outside the developer's active coding context.

max_tokens.description: Bytes of model input, not provider tokens. The v1 field name predates the correction; a token is at least one byte, so the value is always under ARCHITECTURE 12's token maximum.

estimated_tokens.description: Bytes of model input, not provider tokens. The v1 field name predates the correction; a token is at least one byte, so the value is always under ARCHITECTURE 12's token maximum.

items_skipped.description: Evidence that was resolved but not sent, because it did not fit the ceiling. Non-zero means the diagnosis saw less than the session offered.

budget.description: ARCHITECTURE 12. Whichever limit is reached first applies; insufficient evidence within budget is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never automatic context expansion.

evidence_refs.description: What was sent, by local reference. The evidence itself stays in the session record.

estimated_tokens.description: Bytes of model input, not provider tokens. The v1 field name predates the correction; a token is at least one byte, so the value is always under ARCHITECTURE 12's token maximum.

history.description: Earlier commits, mined by `repohone bootstrap`, that the model judged the same problem as this session (contract 1.24). Only commits the session started from are offered. Empty unless the outcome is SUCCESS.

created.description: False when this diagnosis joined an existing fingerprint. Uncontrolled creation of near-duplicates would destroy recurrence measurement (LEARNING_PLAN 9).

fingerprint.description: Which recurring repository-specific problem this is, as distinct from what kind of problem the taxonomy names.

sessions.description: Distinct sessions this fingerprint has been seen in, including this one. 1 is a single observation and weak grounds for a project-level claim.

developers.description: Distinct developers observed hitting it. 1 means the evidence cannot yet distinguish one person's habit from a team-wide pattern (LEARNING_PLAN 8).

scope.description: How far recurrence was counted. Only checkouts on this machine are readable, so this is local recurrence, never team-wide.

complete.description: False when part of the local history could not be read, so the counts are a floor. Absent in records written before contract 1.22, which were only written from complete history.

historical.description: Distinct earlier commits (Phase 6 reverts and fix-ups) that a diagnosis of this fingerprint judged the same problem. Absent before contract 1.24.

corrective_turn.description: The turn containing the developer's correction, identified rather than inferred. Phase 5 validation needs a real correction boundary: two unrelated turns look exactly like a correction and its repair, and validating against a change nobody made certifies nothing. Null means authentic validation is unavailable for this session.

confidence_adjusted.description: Set when Core lowered the model's stated confidence, with why. Recorded rather than applied silently: a reader must be able to see that the certainty on this diagnosis is Core's, not the model's.

then.description: A successful diagnosis carries a cause and a property; anything else is not a diagnosis.
A non-SUCCESS job never leaves a partial diagnosis behind (ARCHITECTURE 12.3: partial output is never a proposal).

allOf.description: From contract 1.24 a diagnosis names its own repository and developer and any history it links; older ones leave the ids to the session record.
